title: Dragon and Oracle
description: A woman in a white toga sits on a blue chaise lounge holding a golden dripping candle while looking at a green dragon wearing a red scarf. The dragon sits on a cracked circular stone platform with golden rings, in front of a large broken window showing an arctic landscape with icebergs and a dark mountain with a glowing symbol at its peak.
prompt: A woman in a white toga sits barefoot on a blue chaise lounge, holding a tall golden candlestick with dripping wax as she gazes at a small green dragon wearing a red scarf. The cheerful dragon sits on a cracked circular stone dais with glowing golden rings. Behind them is a large ornate broken window revealing a frozen arctic sea with icebergs and a dark volcanic mountain topped with a radiant symbol under a sunset sky, in a detailed fantasy illustration style with magical glowing particles
